name: rusty key
desc: The ancient iron key still works.
use_msg: There was a click, and something seemed to open.

name: silver key
desc: A delicate silver key with a magical shimmer.
use_msg: The silver key shines...

name: crystal key
desc: Completely transparent crystal key, virtually invisible.
use_msg: The crystal key melts into the air...

name: rusty iron sword
desc: Covered in rust, but barely usable.

name: iron sword
desc: A common but reliable iron sword.

name: Elf short bow
desc: A short bow made by elves, light and accurate.

name: magic wand
desc: The head of the staff is inlaid with blue gemstones, which contain magical power.

name: Shadow Blade
desc: The jet black dagger barely reflects light.

name: Warhammer
desc: A heavy two-handed war hammer that can break stone with one blow.

name: spear
desc: The tip of the spear glowed with cold light and could pierce armor.

name: Rune Sword
desc: The blade of the sword is engraved with luminous runes, which has extra damage to dark creatures.

name: crossbow
desc: The loaded mechanical crossbow is incredibly powerful.

name: Assassin's Dagger
desc: The dagger coated with highly poisonous blood seals the throat.

name: Thor's Hammer
desc: The hammer body is wrapped with beating arcs of electricity, and there is a faint sound of thunder when it is swung.

name: leather armor
desc: Tanned hard leather armor.

name: Chainmail
desc: Chain mail woven with iron rings.

name: scale armor
desc: Armor made of dragon scales and iron sheets.

name: Mage Robes
desc: Enchanted robe, lightweight and cold-proof.

name: iron shield
desc: A round iron shield, a powerful blocking weapon.

name: iron helmet
desc: An iron helmet to protect the head.

name: small healing potion
desc: Restores 15 HP.

name: Great Healing Potion
desc: Restores 35 HP.

name: magic potion
desc: Restores 20 HP.

name: Fire Elixir
desc: The liquid in the bottle tumbled like lava.
use_msg: You drink the fire potion and your body becomes hot! Causes extra damage to ice enemies!

name: Invisibility Potion
desc: It becomes transparent after drinking.
use_msg: You drink the invisibility potion and your body gradually becomes transparent...it seems to have no other effect.

name: stamina potion
desc: Restores 25 HP.

name: Moonlight Essence
desc: The liquid in the silver bottle flows like moonlight, emitting a soft glow.
use_msg: You drink the moonlight essence and your whole body is surrounded by warm light! Restored 50 points of health!

name: lantern
desc: An old lantern with oil still in it.
use_msg: Lanterns illuminated the surroundings.

name: torch
desc: Turpentine torch.
use_msg: The torches lit up with bright flames.

name: hard bread
desc: Dry brown bread.

name: Dried meat
desc: Savory bacon jerky.

name: fluorescent mushrooms
desc: The shimmering mushrooms, I wonder if they are edible.

name: grilled fish
desc: Delicious grilled fish.

name: magic herbs
desc: Herbs that emit colorful light.

name: Honey
desc: Golden wild honey, very sweet.

name: golden cup
desc: Goblet made of pure gold.

name: silver ring
desc: Silver ring engraved with ancient patterns.

name: emerald gemstone
desc: A thumb-sized green gem.

name: diamond
desc: A perfectly cut diamond.

name: ruby
desc: A blood-red, clear ruby.

name: sapphire
desc: A deep blue gem, like the ocean.

name: ancient crown
desc: A relic of a certain king, studded with precious stones.

name: ancient gold coins
desc: An ancient gold coin with a vague pattern engraved on it.

name: gold ingot
desc: A gold ingot made of pure gold.

name: silver ingot
desc: Silver ingots made of sterling silver.

name: Wolf Fang
desc: The fangs of a giant wolf serve as proof of strength.

name: spider silk
desc: Crystal clear spider silk.

name: dragon scale
desc: The scales falling off the young dragon's body are extremely hard.

name: fairy dust
desc: Glittery powder.

name: mandrake root
desc: Grass roots shaped like humans are said to have magical powers.

name: goblin ears
desc: The goblin's severed ears had a strong smell of blood.

name: snakeskin
desc: The skin shed by the giant python is very tough.

name: Bandit Badge
desc: The bandit leader's identification badge.

name: ancient scroll
desc: Incomprehensible ancient characters.
use_msg: The scroll glows... but cannot be read.

name: teleportation scroll
desc: Record the teleportation spell. Can teleport to any explored location (use teleport scroll <location>).
use_msg: The teleportation scroll flashes. Select an explored location: use teleport scroll <location name or id>

name: hemp rope
desc: 10 meters of strong twine.
use_msg: Maybe it's more useful somewhere else.

name: ancient compass
desc: The pointer points in a special direction.
use_msg: The compass points to the southeast...

name: lock pick
desc: An exquisite set of lock picking tools.
use_msg: You fiddled with the lock pick...it seemed to open something.

name: fishing rod
desc: A slender fishing rod. You can fish by the lake, on the island in the middle of the lake or in the underground river.
use_msg: There is no water here, so there is no way to fish.

name: magnifier
desc: Can observe small things.
use_msg: Through a magnifying glass, you see details that ordinary people cannot see.

name: Adventurer's Diary
desc: A diary left by an adventurer.
use_msg: The diary records: "The gem on the top of the tower is the key to the seal..."

name: Introduction to magic
desc: Basic magic theory.
use_msg: You learned something about magic.

name: magic gem
desc: A gem that emits purple light and contains powerful magic.
use_msg: The gem explodes with dazzling light!

name: holy water
desc: Blessed holy water in a glass bottle.
use_msg: The holy water emits a gentle white light.

name: Phoenix Feather
desc: The fiery red phoenix tail feathers are still warm.
use_msg: The feathers turn into flames, leaving a flame mark on your palm!

name: ice crystals
desc: Eternal ice crystals condensed in extremely cold places.

name: ancient key
desc: A huge stone key, very heavy.
use_msg: The key is so heavy you can barely lift it.

name: life ring
desc: Feel energized while wearing it.
use_msg: The Ring of Life emits a soft green light! Maximum HP +10!

name: Ring of Protection
desc: The wearer gains an invisible shield.

name: power ring
desc: Increases the wearer's strength.

name: mystical talisman
desc: Amulet engraved with ancient runes, its origin is unknown.
use_msg: The amulet shimmers and you feel a mysterious force protecting you.

name: Shabby canvas bag
desc: The heavily worn rucksack could barely hold the essentials.

name: tactical backpack
desc: Foundation standard tactical backpack with multi-layer compartments and excellent load-bearing capabilities.

name: Abnormal storage bag
desc: The interior seems to be larger than the exterior, with a "D-class personnel only" label attached.

name: Secondary key card
desc: Foundation access card, authority level: 2.

name: Level 3 key card
desc: The Foundation's advanced access card allows entry into deep containment areas.

name: Abnormal file fragments
desc: A damaged document bearing the number "SCP-ZH-██" mentions the connection between the fog and the tower.
use_msg: You read: "The fog is not a natural phenomenon, but a leak of unregistered anomalies...The tower may have been an early containment facility." 』

name: Observation log
desc: The researcher's handwritten observation record, with scrawled handwriting.

name: cognitive protection goggles
desc: Foundation-issued goggles to protect against mild cognitive hazards.

name: Portable storage box
desc: A small anomaly containment device that stabilizes unstable cores.

name: memory clearing pills
desc: The foundation's standard A-level memory inhibitor can be used to quickly escape during combat.
use_msg: You swallow the pill and your enemies seem to briefly forget you exist!

name: Stable abnormal core
desc: The defeated abnormal core remains still emit a weak pulse.

name: Site Cleanup Medal
desc: Prove that you suppressed the ultimate threat No. 001. You can continue exploring, or start the second game.

name: Foundation rations
desc: Vacuum-packed military rations that taste like cardboard.

name: Remaining score of the unfinished movement (SCP-ZH-012)
desc: On the bloody staff page, the notes seemed to be extending on their own.
use_msg: You can't help but want to keep writing...your fingers bleed.

name: White Porcelain Mask (SCP-ZH-035)
desc: Smiley white porcelain mask with dried black liquid on the inside.
use_msg: The mask stuck to his face, and a whisper sounded in his ears.

name: Panacea (SCP-ZH-500)
desc: The red capsule is said to cure all injuries and illnesses.
use_msg: You feel like all the pain in your body disappears!

name: [REDACTED](SCP-ZH-055)
desc: You remember picking something up...but can't tell what it is.
use_msg: You stare at it, but you can't remember what you're looking at.

name: Red Sea Disk (SCP-ZH-093)
desc: The blood red stone plate makes a tidal sound when touched.
use_msg: The disc buzzed, as if searching for a certain door.

name: 3D glasses (SCP-ZH-178)
desc: Old-fashioned red and blue 3D glasses, there is something moving at the edge of the field of vision after wearing them.
use_msg: You put on your glasses - a blurry human figure appears in your peripheral vision.

name: Blue Key (SCP-ZH-860)
desc: A blue key with a tree pattern engraved on the handle.
use_msg: The key was slightly warm and pointed to an entrance to another world.

name: Death Day Banquet Script (SCP-ZH-701)
desc: The fragmentary copy of a forbidden tragedy has marks of audience tearing on the margins.
use_msg: After reading the last line, you heard applause coming from the direction of the stage.

name: Rusty Bell (SCP-ZH-513)
desc: The rusty cowbell will ring and you will hear footsteps that should not be there.
use_msg: The bell rang softly... There seemed to be a shadow behind me.

name: Jade Ring (SCP-ZH-714)
desc: The cold jade ring, after wearing it, your thinking slows down, but you become clearer.
use_msg: Wearing a jade ring, you feel slow but safe.

name: Green slime sample (SCP-ZH-447)
desc: Harmless green slime with a label that says: Do not touch corpses.

name: Incomplete Videotape (SCP-ZH-1981)
desc: VHS with blurred labels, the picture changes depending on the number of views.
use_msg: In the snowflake screen, the speaker's face gradually distorted. You gained a glimmer of information.

name: Pocket Dimensional Book (SCP-ZH-1230)
desc: A thick fairy tale book, you can open it and enter a safe dreamland for a moment.
use_msg: You fell into a warm dream, your injuries relieved.

name: Abnormal Cell Phone (SCP-ZH-1471)
desc: It comes pre-installed with social software and always has a dog silhouette on the lock screen.
use_msg: Notification pops up: It says it's always watching you.

name: Crystallized Shard (SCP-ZH-409)
desc: Sharp crystals, the skin feels slightly hard after contact.
use_msg: There was a tingling pain in your fingers, and you quickly put away the pieces.

name: Plague Sample Tube (SCP-ZH-008)
desc: Sealed vial, labeled with biohazard label.
use_msg: You didn't open it - your sanity remained.

name: Shadow Light (SCP-ZH-205)
desc: One of the paired desk lamps, when lit, the shadow on the wall will move on its own.
use_msg: The lights came on and the shadows on the wall began to move slowly.

name: Unfinished Chronicles (SCP-ZH-140)
desc: In books that record a lost civilization, the writing will increase by itself.
use_msg: A new line of words emerges by itself... You close the book.

name: Gene Conversion Stone (SCP-ZH-113)
desc: A smooth red and green stone that changes physiological characteristics upon contact.
use_msg: After a moment of dizziness, you feel stronger.

name: Soul Alloy Sheet (SCP-ZH-148)
desc: The gray metal piece is said to be able to isolate mental interference.

name: Why Action File (SCP-ZH-5000)
desc: The black cover file records a certain out-of-control operation of the Foundation.
use_msg: You read the troubling conclusion that fog may be linked to site crashes.

name: Dimensional snack bag (SCP-ZH-261)
desc: Puffed food with unknown packaging language is surprisingly delicious.
